title: Cardioversion
what: Under brief anesthesia, a short electric shock is given to the chest. It helps the heart go back to a normal rhythm.
why: For atrial fibrillation, atrial flutter, and some other heart rhythm problems.
duration: the procedure itself takes a few minutes, usually 1 to 3 hours in total; sometimes you stay overnight
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. You must not miss them
If you missed blood thinner pills in recent weeks. Be sure to say so

prepare.title: Blood thinners
prepare.text: They are usually taken for several weeks before. Do not miss doses. Sometimes a heart ultrasound through the esophagus is done first.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no food or drink for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Before the procedure
prepare.text: Remove jewelry. Do not put cream on your chest.

prepare.title: Getting home
prepare.text: You cannot drive after anesthesia that day. Have someone take you home.

steps: You lie down, and an IV line is placed
Large pads are stuck on your chest and back
The anesthetist gives medicine, and you fall asleep for a few minutes
The machine gives a short shock, sometimes more than one
You wake up, and an ECG is taken
You are watched for a few hours
feel: You will not feel the shock. You are asleep
The skin on your chest may be red and sore, like after sunburn
after: Keep taking blood thinners exactly as your doctor prescribed
The rhythm may go off again. Your doctor will order a follow-up ECG
red_flags: Chest pain, severe shortness of breath, or fainting: call emergency services
Sudden weakness of an arm or leg, or trouble speaking: call emergency services
A strong, racing heartbeat again: tell your doctor

faq.q: Is a shock to the heart dangerous?
faq.a: It is a long-established procedure. It is done with a doctor and monitors watching, while you sleep.

faq.q: Will the rhythm stay normal for good?
faq.a: Not always. Sometimes the arrhythmia comes back. Your doctor will choose treatment to prevent that.

reminders.text: Cardioversion tomorrow. Do not miss your blood thinners. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you. Arrange a ride home.
